result.description:
Electrical Engineering Technician
Employer: Integra Switchboards Pty Ltd
Location: Brendale, Queensland 4500
Position: Full-time
Salary: AUD 80,000 to A$90,000 per annum plus superannuation, commensurate with skills and experience

Integra Switchboards Pty Ltd is seeking a skilled and experienced Electrical Engineering Technician to join their team in Brendale, Queensland. The successful candidate will support the design, manufacture, testing, commissioning and quality checking of low-voltage electrical switchboards, distribution boards, motor control centres and control panels.
This role is suited to a technically competent person with experience in electrical systems, switchboard manufacture, testing procedures, technical drawings, electrical components and Australian electrical standards.
Key duties and responsibilities
The Electrical Engineering Technician will be responsible for:
•	Assisting Electrical Engineers, project managers and senior technical staff with the design and layout of electrical switchboards, distribution boards, motor control centres, control panels, cabling arrangements and associated electrical systems.
•	Preparing, interpreting and reviewing technical drawings, wiring diagrams, layout drawings, schematics and electrical plans for switchboard manufacturing projects.
•	Conducting tests on electrical systems, components and switchboard assemblies to confirm operational performance, safety and compliance with project specifications.
•	Collecting technical data, recording test results, performing calculations, preparing test documentation, charts, reports and tabulations for engineering and quality assurance purposes.
•	Assisting with estimating material requirements, component quantities, labour requirements and project costs for switchboard and electrical assembly works.
•	Inspecting designs, manufactured switchboards and completed electrical assemblies to ensure compliance with specifications, Australian Standards, client requirements and safety requirements.
•	Assembling, installing, testing, calibrating, modifying and repairing electrical equipment, switchboard components, protection devices, metering equipment, indicating devices and control equipment.
•	Supporting workshop electrical functions, including installation of assemblies for protection relays, metering devices, control circuits and electrical indicating equipment.
•	Assisting with fault finding, technical problem solving and rectification of electrical issues during manufacture, testing and commissioning.
•	Liaising with internal design, fabrication, assembly and project teams to ensure switchboards are delivered accurately, safely and on time.
•	Maintaining accurate technical records, testing records, compliance documents and quality assurance documentation.
•	Ensuring all work is performed in accordance with workplace health and safety requirements, company procedures, project specifications and relevant Australian Standards.
Skills and experience required
Applicants must have:
•	Diploma or Bachelors in Electrical Engineering or related field
•	Atleast 2 years of experience in electrical switchboard manufacture, electrical systems, control panels, distribution boards, motor control centres or similar electrical engineering environments.
•	Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, wiring diagrams, schematics and technical specifications.
•	Experience conducting electrical tests, recording results and assisting with technical reporting.
•	Knowledge of electrical components such as circuit breakers, busbars, contactors, relays, metering equipment, control devices, terminals and cabling systems.
Skills Required
•	Good technical problem-solving skills and strong attention to detail.
•	Ability to work safely and effectively in a workshop/manufacturing environment.
•	Good communication skills and ability to work as part of a technical project team.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Explore a world of career opportunities with us across every state of Australia, including New South Wales, Victoria, Queensland, Western Australia, South Australia, Tasmania, the Australian Capital Territory, and the Northern Territory. Join our dynamic team today and start your journey in the state that feels like home.

Offshore Staff Assist is currently hiring for a broad range of positions across various sectors on behalf of our client. We recognize your enthusiasm for becoming a part of our team and are keen to support your professional development. Our focus on excellence and innovation is at the core of our business, offering a solid foundation for your skills to develop and succeed. 
We are not just offering jobs, but long-term career opportunities that promise growth and advancement within the company we service. If you're looking for a role where your contributions are valued and your professional growth is a priority, please join us to build a future where your career aspirations align with our commitment to progress and hard work.
We're currently looking for qualified: 
•	Motor Mechanic (General)
•	Auto Electrician 
•	Diesel Motor Mechanic
•	Small Engine Mechanic (Including Outboard)
•	Upholsterer (Outboard/Marine, Vehicle and Custom)
•	Motorcycle Mechanic 
•	Fitter General (Including Heavy)

To be considered for the below roles, you must have a minimum 3 years’ experience.

Motor Mechanic (General)
We are seeking a skilled Motor Vehicle Mechanic to join our team. The ideal candidate will be experienced in diagnosing and repairing various makes and models of cars, utilizing advanced diagnostic tools to troubleshoot issues, and performing routine maintenance and repairs. A strong understanding of automotive systems and a commitment to delivering high-quality workmanship are essential.
Auto Electrician
Join our team as an Auto Electrician, where you will be responsible for installing, maintaining, and repairing electrical wiring and electronic components in motor vehicles. The ideal candidate should have expertise in reading technical diagrams and manuals, as well as a solid foundation in handling various electrical systems within the automotive industry.
Diesel Motor Mechanic
We are looking for a Diesel Motor Mechanic to manage the maintenance and repair of diesel engines. The role involves inspecting engine components, diagnosing issues for efficient resolution, and performing preventive maintenance to ensure the longevity and reliability of diesel-powered vehicles. Knowledge of modern diagnostic tools and techniques for diesel engines is required.
Small Engine Mechanic (Including Outboard)
Our team requires a Small Engine Mechanic skilled in repairing and maintaining engines used in power equipment such as lawn mowers, chain saws, and snow blowers. Candidates should possess detailed knowledge of small engine operations and the ability to troubleshoot fuel, mechanical, and electrical systems effectively.
Outboard mechanics must test and repair boat engines and related, electrical systems, navigational equipment, hulls, propellers. Including steering and air conditioning where required.
Upholsterer (Outboard/Marine, Vehicle and Custom)
We seek an upholsterer with experience working on outboard, vehicles including light and heavy rigid. Experience in seat, fit out repair. Fixing trim, making repairs to wooden frames and items, removal of defective equipment and materials. Experience on custom made manifolds, wrappings and bespoke material and equipment. Cost analysis and repair estimation of items, fabric and materials required.
Motorcycle Mechanic
We are in search of a Motorcycle Mechanic to handle diagnostics, repairs, and servicing of motorcycles and similar vehicles. This role requires a deep understanding of motorcycle mechanics, including engine components, suspension, and electrical systems. The ideal candidate should demonstrate a passion for motorcycles and a drive to deliver excellent service.
Fitter General (Including Heavy)
A Fitter position is available for professional skill in maintaining and repairing automated systems, plant and also heavy-duty machinery and equipment. Responsibilities include performing major repair work, conducting inspections to ensure compliance with safety regulations, and troubleshooting hydraulic and pneumatic systems. Experience with construction, mining, or agricultural machinery is highly advantageous.

result.description:
Full-time Passive Fire Protection Equipment Technician position available with competitive salary. Work in a dynamic team in NSW.

3 Stand-out Bullet Points:
•	Full-Time Fire Protection Equipment Technician
•	Salary Range: $90,000 - $105,000 per annum plus superannuation
•	Exciting opportunity to work in a professional setting.

About Us
Essential Passive Fire Protection Services Pty Ltd is a proudly Australian-owned and operated company dedicated to delivering premier facility maintenance and safety solutions. We specialise in comprehensive fire protection services, ensuring that commercial, industrial, and residential properties remain safe, compliant, and fully operational. Our commitment to excellence, regulatory compliance, and workplace safety forms the foundation of our operations, enabling us to provide unparalleled service to our diverse client base.

About the role
The Passive Fire Protection Equipment Technician is responsible for ensuring that all passive fire containment systems are correctly installed, inspected, tested, and maintained in strict compliance with the Building Code of Australia (BCA) and applicable Australian Standards, primarily AS 1851. The role involves working with a variety of passive fire systems, including but not limited to fire-rated batts, wraps, mastic, collars, seals, fire doors, smoke doors, and fire shutters.

Duties and Responsibilities

•	Install, repair, and maintain passive fire containment systems, including fire-rated batts, wraps, mastic, collars, seals, fire/smoke doors, and shutters.
•	Ensure all installations and maintenance works are executed in accordance with manufacturer specifications, the BCA, and relevant Australian Standards.
•	Select and apply appropriate fire-stopping materials for various penetrations and construction joints.
•	Conduct routine inspections and preventative maintenance testing of passive fire protection systems in accordance with AS 1851.
•	Assess the integrity of fire compartments, fire doors, smoke doors, and fire shutters.
•	Identify, diagnose, and report on defects, non-conformances, or compromised fire separations.
•	Perform necessary rectification and repair works on non-compliant passive fire systems to restore full regulatory compliance.
•	Provide technical recommendations for the upgrade or replacement of obsolete or irreparably damaged passive fire infrastructure.
•	Accurately complete and submit service reports, logbooks, defect notices, and compliance certificates in a timely manner.

This hands-on role is central to delivering reliable, dealership-level service without the dealership price tag, ensuring vehicles leave the workshop performing safely and smoothly while supporting the growth of a specialist independent business.
Key Responsibilities:
Diagnose mechanical and electrical faults using advanced diagnostic equipment (including Xentry/ISTA and similar systems) and interpret live data and fault codes accurately.
Perform scheduled logbook servicing and routine maintenance to manufacturer specifications.
Repair and replace components including engines, transmissions, braking systems, steering, suspension, cooling systems, clutches and related mechanical assemblies.
Carry out auto electrical repairs, battery/charging system diagnostics, and air conditioning inspections, leak testing and re-gassing.
Dismantle, inspect, repair or replace worn or defective parts and reassemble components to correct specifications, referring to service manuals and technical data.
Road-test vehicles where required and verify repairs meet performance and safety standards.
Maintain a clean, organised and safe workshop environment, complete job cards accurately and communicate findings clearly to the business owner/customers.
Source and fit OEM or equivalent high-grade parts and support transparent quoting processes.
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Certificate III in Automotive Technology, Certificate III in Light Vehicle Mechanical Technology, or an equivalent recognised qualification.
Minimum 4 years’ experience as a qualified Automotive Technician / Motor Mechanic.
Strong technical skills in diagnosing and repairing modern European vehicles, including familiarity with electronic control systems and diagnostic software.
Excellent attention to detail, problem-solving ability, clear communication skills and a professional, customer-focused approach.
Ability to work independently, follow manufacturer procedures, and maintain high standards of workmanship and workshop safety.
How to Apply:
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and technically proficient Telecommunications Network Engineer to join our team and take ownership of the planning, design, implementation, and ongoing monitoring of complex telecommunications networks and broadcasting systems. The successful candidate will bring a strong engineering mindset, a methodical approach to problem-solving, and the ability to work across diverse hardware and software environments. This role suits an experienced professional who thrives in a fast-paced, technically demanding environment and is committed to delivering reliable, high-performance communications infrastructure.
## Key Responsibilities
- Design, build, configure, and commission telecommunications devices, networks, and systems, ensuring seamless interoperability across equipment from multiple manufacturers, service providers, and end users
- Develop and present engineering project proposals that clearly define project goals, scope, background, justification, and estimated costs to support informed decision-making by stakeholders
- Evaluate, test, and procure new telecommunications products, services, and technologies, ensuring selections align with organisational requirements and long-term strategic objectives
- Identify, analyse, and diagnose faults and deficiencies within existing network systems, determining the most effective corrective measures to resolve current issues and prevent future disruptions
- Determine appropriate hardware and software configurations to achieve desired system performance, reliability, and scalability across all network environments
- Prepare, interpret, and maintain technical specifications, engineering drawings, and regulatory documentation to support the safe and compliant use of telecommunications equipment
- Determine the optimal type and arrangement of circuits, transformers, circuit-breakers, transmission lines, and associated infrastructure components
- Develop new network sites by conducting location assessments, preparing and lodging required documentation, producing technical drawings, and managing approvals through to completion
- Monitor network systems on an ongoing basis, proactively identifying performance anomalies and taking corrective action to maintain service continuity
- Assess current hardware and software performance levels to forecast future capacity needs, and develop short and long-term upgrade plans to enhance capability and system efficiency
- Ensure all telecommunications activities are carried out in full compliance with relevant Australian laws, regulations, industry standards, and internal policies and procedures
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, contractors, and external vendors to deliver network projects on time, within scope, and to the required technical standard
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
- Demonstrated experience in the design, deployment, and management of telecommunications networks in a professional environment
- Proficiency in network protocols, transmission technologies, and telecommunications infrastructure, including fibre optic, microwave, and IP-based systems
- Strong understanding of relevant Australian telecommunications regulations, standards, and compliance frameworks
- Experience in preparing and interpreting technical specifications, engineering drawings, and project documentation
- Proficiency in network monitoring and diagnostic tools, with the ability to analyse performance data and respond effectively to system issues
- Solid understanding of hardware and software configuration across diverse telecommunications platforms and vendor ecosystems
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess complex technical issues and develop practical solutions
- Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously
- Valid Australian driver's licence (where site-based travel is required)
## Preferred Qualifications
- Postgraduate qualifications in Telecommunications, Network Engineering, or a related discipline
- Industry certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, or equivalent vendor-neutral or vendor-specific credentials
- Experience with 4G/5G mobile network technologies and associated infrastructure
- Familiarity with SDN (Software-Defined Networking) and network virtualisation technologies
- Knowledge of broadcast and media transmission systems and associated engineering standards
- Previous experience working within utilities, government, or critical infrastructure environments
- Project management qualifications or experience, such as PRINCE2 or PMP certification
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a forward-thinking organisation investing in next-generation telecommunications infrastructure, giving you exposure to cutting-edge technologies and large-scale engineering projects
- Enjoy a collaborative and inclusive workplace culture that values technical expertise, continuous improvement, and professional development
- Access ongoing training, industry certifications, and career progression pathways tailored to your engineering goals
- Benefit from flexible working arrangements designed to support a healthy work-life balance
- Competitive remuneration package with opportunities for performance-based growth
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super
